summary: US stocks finished lower Tuesday after the hot October CPI report. The Dow fell 0.3% to 52,231.89, the S&P 500 fell about 0.4% to roughly 7,520 and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.74% to 25,065.87, paring deeper intraday losses. Nvidia was the worst Dow performer, down 5.47% at $168.89 and nearly 30% below early October. Decliners beat advancers about 2 to 1 on the NYSE.
title: Stocks close lower after hot CPI; Nvidia drops 5.5%
